name: English
_note: Per-language strings for self_model.py. Cues are regexes over the NORMALISED utterance (casefolded, accents stripped, punctuation trimmed, leading 'hey zoe' / trailing 'please' removed) and must match the WHOLE utterance. A cue may only ROUTE a turn to a deterministic answer built from the generated self-model; it never grants a capability. tests/test_self_model.py pins every group, dark flag, unsupported id and memory rule against the registries.

capabilities: how can you help(?: me| us)?
tell me what you can do
can_you: is it possible for you to (?P<x>.+)
tools: what (?:tools|apps|skills|integrations|services|abilities) (?:do you have|can you use|are you using|are available)
what do you have access to
how_remember: how do you remember(?: things| stuff)?
do you (?:remember|keep) (?:everything|what i say|everything i say)
how long do you (?:remember|keep) (?:things|stuff|what i say|it)
where do you keep what i tell you
listening: are you (?:always |constantly )?(?:listening|recording)(?: to (?:me|us))?(?: all the time| all day| right now)?
do you (?:always |constantly )?(?:listen|record)(?: to (?:me|us|everything))?(?: all the time| all day)?
know_me: do you know who i am
do you know who you(?:'re| are) (?:talking|speaking) (?:to|with)
can you tell who i am
how do you know who i am
how do you know it(?:'s| is) me
running_on: what (?:hardware|computer|device|model|brain|llm|ai) are you(?: running on| using| built on| based on| running)?
what are you (?:made of|built on|based on|powered by)
do you send (?:my |our )?(?:data|stuff|things|what i say) (?:to the cloud|anywhere|out)
cannot: what are you not able to do
what are you unable to do
what is out of your reach
used_to_answer: what did you (?:just )?use to (?:answer|work that out|say that|figure that out|find that|answer that|answer me)
how did you (?:just )?(?:answer|work that out|figure that out|get that|come up with that)
where did that answer come from

purchase.name: order or buy things
purchase.no: I can't order or buy anything for you.
purchase.instead: I can add it to your shopping list, though.

message_others.name: send emails or texts to other people
message_others.no: I can't send emails or texts.
message_others.instead: I can set a reminder for you to do it, though.

phone.name: make phone calls
phone.no: I can't make or answer phone calls.
phone.instead: I can set a reminder for you to make the call, though.

money.name: handle money or payments
money.no: I can't move money or pay anything.
money.instead: I can set a reminder for the due date, though.

devices.name: control anything in the house except the lights
devices.no: I can only control the lights in the house, nothing else yet.
devices.instead: I can do the lights, though.

travel.name: book travel or tickets
travel.no: I can't book flights, hotels, rides or tickets.
travel.instead: I can put the trip in your calendar, though.

lists.label: your lists
lists.do: keep your shopping and to-do lists
lists.ask: add milk to my shopping list

timers.label: timers
timers.ask: set a timer for ten minutes

reminders.label: reminders
reminders.ask: remind me to call the plumber at five

notes.label: notes
notes.ask: make a note that the spare key is in the shed

people.label: your contacts
people.do: keep track of the people in your life

media.label: music
media.do: play music and control the volume

home.label: the lights
home.do: turn the lights on, off, up or down

memory.label: your memory
memory.ask: remember that my favourite tea is peppermint

dark.web_lookup: look things up on the live web
dark.spoken_brief: speak up first with a morning brief
dark.fix_note: correct a stored note when you say it's wrong
dark.retire_fact: drop a fact for good when you tell me it has ended
dark.verify: double-check myself on the web when you ask "are you sure?"
dark.persona: adapt my manner to each person
dark.telegram_media: understand voice notes and photos on Telegram

memory.kept: I keep the facts and moments you tell me, with the day you said them.
memory.remember_ask: Say "remember that" and I'll keep it word for word.
memory.never_kept: I keep nothing about guests, and nothing you tell me is kept if you say it's off the record.
memory.off_record: Say "off the record" and I won't keep the next thing you say.
memory.forgotten: When you ask me to forget something it stays forgotten{forget_tail}.
memory.provenance: Ask me "why did you say that?" and I'll show you where it came from.
memory.local_store: It all stays in a private store on this box.

egress.web_lookup: a web lookup, when you ask for one, sends that search out
egress.telegram: anything you type on Telegram travels over Telegram

state.asleep: asleep, and it starts when asked
state.night_open: I'm in my overnight thinking window

capabilities: I'm Zoe, your home assistant. You can reach me on {surfaces}.
Just ask me for any of it.
tools: If you ask for something that isn't on that list, I'll tell you I can't do it.
cannot: If I'm not sure, I'll tell you rather than guess.
listening: I only listen for "{wake}" on the panel, and that part happens on the device itself.
Until you say it, nothing you say is recorded or sent anywhere.
After it, what you say goes to this box to be turned into text, never to the cloud.
In the web voice session I listen for as long as you keep it open.
answers.audio_clause: Short clips of what you say after the wake word are being kept on this box so the voice system can be tested.
answers.ambient_clause: Background capture at the panel is switched on.
know_me_yes: Yes - you're {name}, and I know that from your account.
know_me_guest: I don't know who you are - you're not signed in, so I treat you as a guest and keep nothing.
know_me_unverified: I couldn't tell who was speaking, so I haven't said anything - say it again once I know it's you.
see_me: The panel has a camera, and I only use it to recognise people who have chosen to enrol their face.
I never keep pictures or video.
running_on: I run on a small computer in your home, a {hardware}.
All of it runs on this box, so what you say isn't sent to a cloud model.
The only things that leave it: {egress}.
answers.models_line: My thinking is {brain}, my hearing is {stt}, my voice is {tts}, and a small {router} sorts out quick requests
made_by: I'm Zoe, a home assistant built for this household and run here on its own computer.
who_are_you: I'm Zoe, a home assistant that lives on a computer in your home.
Ask me what I can do for the rest.
used_self_model: That came from my own description of what I can do, put together from my settings when I started up - not from anything you told me.

block.header: ABOUT ME (generated from my settings; answer questions about myself from this and nothing else; never claim a capability that is not listed)
